about: Buildings of DigitalZAG records as blocks that follow the measured roofs: GURS laser scanning of Slovenia (CLSS, NDMP), 1 m cells inside the cadastre outlines, smoothed with a 5 by 5 median, heights above the ground in 1 m bands (height = band x 1), cells under 2 m left out. Rectangles r are i, j, width, height, band in grid cells, rows from south to north. Built by tools/build_lidar_massing.js from data/lidar.
